items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Who else was involved in The Real Ambassadors production... [INTERVIEWEE] Carmen [McRae]. That was about it.

ctx.x: Who else was involved in The Real Ambassadors production. I know it was Dave Brubeck’s project. Louis Armstrong. Yourself – Lambert, Hendricks, and Ross. Who else?

Carmen [McRae]. That was about it. Dave was always very sweet. When he came to England at one point, in Birmingham, England, he had me on a t.v. show that we did. But I wasn’t in great health, I don’t think. I was recovering. I just have to laugh, because I think of the term now that they use, self- medicating. Oooo. There wasn’t no self-medication.
Jazz Ambassadors was in 1961. In 1962 I’d like to verify that Lambert, Hendricks, and Ross did receive a Grammy for best vocal performance.
